caption: The drawing features two stylized yellow birds with red crowns, black facial markings, and white and red wings, facing toward each other and perched on either side of a symmetrical, white-trunked tree with red and white leaves and a central red diamond near the base. The background is a muted grayish-blue, bordered by a tan strip along the left and right edges. Above the illustration is the text "FOLK ART OF THE PENNSYLVANIA GERMANS" in a combination of red and black uppercase letters. Below the illustrated birds and tree, the following text appears in black and red, also in uppercase: "SELECTED BY THE INDEX OF AMERICAN DESIGN PENNSYLVANIA ART PROJECT WORK PROJECTS ADMINISTRATION." The composition is balanced, with the visual elements and text centrally aligned on the page.
title: Study for Portfolio Cover: "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
